stem:
Aarav stands 2 m in front of a plane mirror. He then steps back until he is 5 m from the mirror.

What happens to the apparent distance of his image behind the mirror?

options.text: It increases from 2 m to 5 m.
It decreases from 2 m to 0 m.
It stays zero because the image lies on the mirror surface.
The same change from 2 m to 5 m would hold for every kind of mirror.

teacher.key_rationale: For a plane mirror, image distance equals object distance, so stepping farther from the mirror makes the image appear farther behind it.
